title: 第25章 灭唐家庄斩杀唐日天第26章 前往海泽国度唐山通往黄泉的倒计时
lines: 轰隆隆，巨响传来。
祭坛之上缓缓出现一个白衣老者的身影，身姿轻盈，如天上仙人一般。
目光之中充斥着傲慢与不屑。
“小辈，唤本尊前来，所为何事！”
他乃是唐家庄弟子，百年间都未下界执行过任务了，本以为乐得清闲，没想到今日竟然被召唤下界，他心中也有不爽。
他可是高高在上的唐家庄子弟，这贫瘠落后的、灵气寡薄的下界，他一刻都不想待。
唐山恭恭敬敬的回应道：“回禀先祖，我乃此界唐家庄子弟。”
“苍玄界唐家庄都被此人一人屠尽，我一人孤身逃遁于此，他还想要赶尽杀绝，还望先祖为我主持公道！”
“哦？！”老者目光中流露杀机，瞬间锁定顾云之身。
“炼虚巅峰？”
“只有这点实力也能灭此界唐家庄道统？真不愧是下界之人，都是一群废物！”
“小子，说吧，你想要怎么死！”
老者语气淡漠，俨然已经将顾云当成一个死人。
唐山虽然被嘲讽，但是心中反而是升起一阵快意，瞟向有些害怕的舞月婵的方向，无比得意。
这就是你的选择！愚蠢的女人，比背景，我唐山根本就不虚这个上界公子哥！
“先祖，还请留下那个女人的寿命，她本是晚辈的道侣，晚辈一定要给她最深刻的教训！”
此刻的唐山脸上的狞笑让舞月婵觉得陌生。
“好好，你放心吧。”
“到时候，别忘了本尊的功劳！”
老者眼中也露出光亮，好美丽的女子，竟然被这下界土着糟蹋了，真的是浪费！
唐山心中怒喷，但是脸上还是堆笑：“谨遵老祖指示。”
“小子，想好了吗？我的耐心可是有限的！”
“区区道宫一重境，你也敢自称本尊？”
突然，一道冰冷刺骨的声音在老者耳边响起，一道身影不知何时出现在了他的身后，一柄闪着寒光的匕首已经切进去大半。
老者不愧是道宫境的强者，竟然来得及说出一句话：“怎么可能？”
下一秒，人头落地，与之前唐日天如出一辙，在唐山面前滚动两圈，最后还弹了一下。
唐山人傻了，刚刚说的牛逼哄哄的，结果一招都还没打就被秒掉了。
不是说道宫境强者都是有道宫异象的吗？施展都还没有施展，差距不是一般的大！
落在地上的人头竟然嘴巴还张开，冷冷开口：“这不过是我的一道灵身而已，你敢对我出手，唐家庄绝对会找到你在上界的道统，并将之全部灭绝！”
影儿的实力显然也在道宫之上，但是老者不认为自己就比对方弱上多少，毕竟她是偷袭得手，众所周知，偷袭一般是因为正面战场打不过对手，唐家庄之所以知道的这么清楚，就是因为他们就是偷袭的好手，分析自己的心理那是手到擒来。
所以，影儿也一定是这样。
老者的本体乃是道宫三重境的修为，绝对能把这个女人按在地上摩擦！
老者眼中喷涌着怒火，看向影儿：“到时候我一定让你这女人，生不如死！！”
话音落下，全场寂静。
“哼，被吓傻了吧，我告诉你，唐家庄那可是有道身境强者坐镇的，你们在上界的道统，也会因为你们的愚蠢彻底葬送！”
寂静，死一般的寂静。
“说话，你们说话啊！”感受到生机一点点溃散，老者没看到想象中的恐惧，心中不悦。
content_en:
Rumble, loud noise came.
A figure of an old man in white slowly appeared on the altar. His figure was as light as a fairy in the sky.
His eyes were full of arrogance and disdain.
"Junior, call me here, what are you doing!"
He is a disciple of Tangjiazhuang and has not performed a mission in the lower world in a hundred years. He thought he was enjoying his time and leisure, but he did not expect to be summoned to the lower world today. He also felt unhappy.
He was a descendant of Tangjiazhuang, a high-ranking man. He didn't want to stay in this barren, backward, spiritually weak lower world for a moment.
Tangshan responded respectfully: "Reporting to my ancestors, I am a descendant of Tangjiazhuang in this world."
"The entire Tang family village in Cangxuan Realm was slaughtered by this man alone. I am escaping here alone. He still wants to kill them all. I hope my ancestors will uphold justice for me!"
"Oh?!" The old man's eyes revealed murderous intent, and he instantly locked onto Gu Yun.
"The peak of virtual refining?"
"With only this little strength, can you destroy the Tangjiazhuang Taoism in this world? They are indeed a bunch of trash from the lower world!"
"Boy, tell me how you want to die!"
The old man's tone was indifferent, as if he had regarded Gu Yun as a dead person.
Although Tang Shan was ridiculed, he felt a burst of joy in his heart. He glanced in the direction of Wu Yuechan, who was a little scared, feeling extremely proud.
The choice is yours! Stupid woman, compared to my background, I, Tangshan, am not worthy of this upper-world young man!
"Ancestor, please keep that woman's lifespan alive. She was originally a Taoist companion of this junior generation. This junior generation must give her the most profound lesson!"
The ferocious smile on Tangshan's face at this moment made Wu Yuechan feel strange.
"Okay, don't worry."
"When the time comes, don't forget my contribution!"
The old man's eyes also showed light. Such a beautiful woman was ruined by the natives of the lower world. It was really a waste!
Tangshan was furious in his heart, but still had a smile on his face: "I will follow the instructions of my ancestor."
"Boy, have you thought about it? My patience is limited!"
"You are only in the first level of Dao Palace, but you dare to call yourself me?"
Suddenly, a cold and biting voice sounded in the old man's ears. A figure appeared behind him at some point, and a dagger with a cold light had already cut into half of it.
The old man is worthy of being a strong man in the Dao Palace realm, and he actually had time to say: "How is it possible?"
The next second, the head fell to the ground, just like Tang Ritian before, rolling twice in front of Tangshan and finally bouncing.
The Tangshan people were dumbfounded. They were so awesome and coaxing just now, but they were instantly defeated before even a single move was made.
Isn’t it said that those who are powerful in the Dao Palace realm all have visions of the Dao Palace? The cast has not been cast yet, the gap is not as big as usual!
The head that fell on the ground still had its mouth open, and he said coldly: "This is just a spiritual body of mine. If you dare to attack me, Tangjiazhuang will definitely find your orthodoxy in the upper world and exterminate them all!"
Ying'er's strength is obviously higher than that of Dao Palace, but the old man doesn't think that he is much weaker than the opponent. After all, she succeeded in a sneak attack. As we all know, sneak attacks are usually because the opponent cannot beat the opponent in the frontal battlefield. The reason why Tangjiazhuang knows so clearly is because they are good at sneak attacks, and they can easily analyze their own psychology.
Therefore, Yinger must be like this too.
The old man's true body is the cultivation level of the third level of the Tao Palace. He can definitely press this woman to the ground and rub her!
The old man's eyes were filled with anger and he looked at Ying'er: "When the time comes, I will definitely make life worse than death for you, a woman!!"
After the words fell, the whole place was silent.
"Hmph, you must have been scared to death. Let me tell you, there are powerful Taoists in Tangjiazhuang. Your Taoism in the upper world will be completely ruined because of your stupidity!"
Silence, deathly silence.
"Speak, you guys speak!" Feeling the vitality disappearing little by little, the old man did not see the fear he imagined and was unhappy in his heart.
title_en: Chapter 25: Destroying Tangjiazhuang and beheading Tang Ritian Chapter 26: Countdown to Tangshan, the country of Haize, leading to the underworld
